_comment: Hit requirements, and the talents that contribute towards them.
In vanilla a level 60 attacking a higher-level target misses more, so the hit needed depends
entirely on what you are fighting. These are the standard 1.12 numbers for a level 60 with
The talent list is taken from OctoWoW's own talent calculator rather than assumed from vanilla,
because several of these do not exist in vanilla at all - Paladin Precision, Priest Piercing
Light, Shaman Elemental Devastation and Druid Genesis are all server additions. Re-run the
scraper with --talents and re-read data/talents.json if the trees are rebalanced.
_weaponSkillComment: Weapon skill only affects melee, and it matters far more than it looks. Vanilla applies a
steeper miss penalty once the target's defense exceeds your weapon skill by more than 10, so
a level 63 boss (315 defense) punishes 300 skill badly - and the first five points, which take
you to 305 and back under that threshold, are worth 3% hit on their own. Points past 305 give
OctoWoW grants +5 per weapon type through the Fray Island quest chain: start Iron Determination
at level 55+, then Sakgoth offers a quest for each weapon you can use. That is why 305 is an
option here rather than an assumption.
meleeCapBySkill is keyed by weapon skill. Values in between are interpolated, and anything above
the highest key falls off at perPointAbove305.

weaponSkill.note: The quest chain grants +5 for one weapon type at a time, so this applies to whichever weapon you have trained.

targets.name: Players (PvP)
targets.blurb: Other level 60 players. The easiest cap to reach, and the one that matters in battlegrounds and world PvP.
targets.weaponSkillNote: Against an equal-level target you are already at the floor, so weapon skill buys nothing here.

targets.name: Mobs (level 60-62)
targets.blurb: Ordinary dungeon and raid trash. Worth capping for if you spend a lot of time clearing.

targets.name: Bosses (level 63)
targets.blurb: Raid bosses are three levels above you, which is why the raiding hit cap is so much higher.
targets.spellNote: A level 63 target has 17% spell miss, but 1% of that cannot be removed by hit at all - 16% is the real cap.
targets.dualWieldNote: White swings while dual wielding carry a further 19% penalty, so the 28% needed is not reachable from gear. Cap special attacks first and ignore the rest.
targets.weaponSkillNote: The five points from the weapon skill quest are worth 3% hit here - more than any single piece of gear.

_talentComment: schools: when present, the talent only helps a spec whose school is in this list. A Shadow
priest gets Shadow Focus; a Holy one does not.
perRank: hit percentage granted by each point.
_excludedComment: Deliberately not counted, because they do not move the cap you actually gear for:
Dual Wield Specialization (warrior) - off-hand white hits only, and white dual-wield hit is
Bestial Precision (hunter), Demonic Precision (warlock) - pet hit, not yours.
Improved Hand of Reckoning (paladin), Wand Specialization - single-ability hit.
Blinding Haze (rogue) - reduces the target's hit, not yours.
